import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data):
    if isinstance(data, pd.Series):
        df = data.to_frame()
    elif isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame):
        df = data.copy()
    else:
        df = pd.DataFrame(data)
        if df.ndim == 1:
            df = df.to_frame()

    if df.empty:
        result = df.copy()
        result["Average"] = pd.Series(dtype=float, index=result.index)
        _, ax = plt.subplots()
        ax.bar(result.index.astype(str), result["Average"])
        ax.set_xlabel("Row")
        ax.set_ylabel("Average")
        ax.set_title("Average Values")
        return result, ax

    if df.shape[1] == 0:
        result = df.copy()
        result["Average"] = float("nan")
        _, ax = plt.subplots()
        ax.bar(result.index.astype(str), result["Average"])
        ax.set_xlabel("Row")
        ax.set_ylabel("Average")
        ax.set_title("Average Values")
        return result, ax

    try:
        numeric_df = df.apply(pd.to_numeric)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ValueError("All input data must be numeric or convertible to numeric.") from exc

    if numeric_df.replace([float("inf"), float("-inf")], pd.NA).isna().any().any():
        if numeric_df.isin([float("inf"), float("-inf")]).any().any():
            raise ValueError("Input data must not contain infinite values.")

    scaler = MinMaxScaler()
    scaled = scaler.fit_transform(numeric_df)

    result = pd.DataFrame(scaled, columns=df.columns, index=df.index)
    result["Average"] = result.mean(axis=1, skipna=True)

    _, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.bar(result.index.astype(str), result["Average"])
    ax.set_xlabel("Row")
    ax.set_ylabel("Average")
    ax.set_title("Average Values")

    return result, ax
